select * from t_login_log
AND user_id = #{query.userId}
AND user_type = #{query.userType}
AND login_ip LIKE '%' || replace(replace(replace(#{query.ip}, '\', '\\'), '%', '\%'), '_', '\_') || '%'
AND create_time >= CAST(#{query.startDate} AS date)
AND create_time < CAST(#{query.endDate} AS date) + INTERVAL '1 day'
AND user_name LIKE '%' || replace(replace(replace(#{query.userName}, '\', '\\'), '%', '\%'), '_', '\_') || '%'
order by create_time desc
